title: 第十五章 尸寒成霜第十六章 咄咄怪事

“一派胡言，这世界上哪有什么僵尸？”
眼镜男对九叔的说法嗤之以鼻，招了招手：“来人，将这个有重大嫌疑的人犯给我押回警局，慢慢审问。”
九叔：“……”
拜入茅山的所有弟子，在登名入册的时候，都会对着开派祖师的神像发誓，不作奸犯科，不残害生灵，不招惹官府。
誓言有没有效力九叔不知道，但这些年来他从未违背过，甚至将其当做自己的人生准则。
因此哪怕他用一柄桃木剑就能把这些带枪的警察全部打倒，哪怕是蒙受了不白之冤，在自己的人身安全受到威胁之前，他也不会与警察进行武装冲突。
而在原著中，面对阿威队长的强行缉拿，九叔就没有反抗，任由对方把他锁入牢房，引出了任老爷狱中尸变，奸人威险死还生的滑稽戏。
不过现在九叔身边多出了秦尧这个变数，局势自然不会再一成不变的上演……
“如果你想找死，并且连累家族的话，尽管这么做好了。”秦尧挡住两名持枪的警察，一脸冷漠地看向阿威队长。
阿威闻声望去，目光撞上那对冰冷的眸子，一股深入骨髓般的寒气骤然涌上心头，令其心神一颤，乃至毛骨悚然。
气势这东西，摸不着，闻不到，却能看得见。
对于普通人来说，气势大多来源于阶级威压，来自于官位的天然属性。可对于秦尧这种“天赋异禀”的人来说，一瞪眼，一皱眉，就足以使常人胆寒。
此为凶威。
属于长相优势。
“混账，你居然敢威胁本队长，知不知道枪打在身上几个眼儿？”迟些，回过神来的阿威心里产生了一阵应激反应，越害怕，越要展现出自己凶狠的一面，抽出腰间的手枪对准秦尧额头。
秦尧闪身到他面前，劈手夺过手枪，双手一搓，外表精致的枪身瞬间被捏成一团铁疙瘩。
“嘭！”
在一众警察见了鬼的表情下，秦尧猛地将手中铁块砸向地面，只见在一声震耳欲聋般的巨响过后，地面上多出了一个深不见底的黑洞，洞口周围布满裂痕。
“枪都拿不稳，你这镇保安队长的职位是怎么来的？”

低头望着距离自己双脚仅有二指的黑洞，阿威狠狠打了一个寒颤，心中的那点优越感顷刻间消散一空。
开顽笑，他的血肉之躯哪有洋灰铺成的地面硬？
有这力道，对方随便在路上捡一个石子就能打穿他脑袋，这种人间凶器显然不是他可以招惹的！
“发什么愣呢？”秦尧伸手拍了拍他肩膀。
“好汉饶命。”幻想到自己脑袋开花的场景，阿威全身的汗毛都竖了起来，双手抱拳，单膝跪地。
秦尧：“……”
这种服软的姿势还是第一次见。
“师父，师弟好威风啊！”一旁，文才凑到九叔耳边，轻声说道。
语气中满满的羡慕。
九叔扫了他一眼：“如果你平时肯勤奋修行，现在威风的就是你了。”
文才：“……”
瞎鸡……乱讲。
师弟的法术修为和我一样，都是人师三重，他能这么猛靠的全是天赋，和修为有什么关系？
“你现在嘴上服了软，其实心里还是不服的，对吧？”秦尧斜睨着阿威队长，似笑非笑。

"That's nonsense. How can there be any zombies in this world?"
The bespectacled man sneered at Uncle Jiu's statement and waved his hand: "Come here, take this major suspect to me and escort him back to the police station for interrogation slowly."
Uncle Jiu: "..."
All disciples who worship in Maoshan will swear to the statue of the founder of the sect when registering that they will not commit any crime, harm any living being, or provoke the government.
Uncle Jiu didn't know if the oath had any effect, but he had never violated it over the years, and even regarded it as his own rule of life.
Therefore, even if he can knock down all these armed police officers with a mahogany sword, and even if he has been wronged, he will not engage in armed conflict with the police until his personal safety is threatened.
In the original work, when faced with Captain Ah Wei's forcible arrest, Uncle Jiu did not resist and allowed the other party to lock him into the cell, which led to the comical scene of Master Ren transforming into a corpse in prison and the traitor threatening to return to life.
But now that Qin Yao is a variable around Uncle Jiu, the situation will naturally not play out the same way again...
"If you want to die and bring trouble to the family, just do this." Qin Yao blocked the two policemen with guns and looked at Captain Ah Wei with an indifferent expression.
Awei heard the sound and looked away, his eyes met those cold eyes, and a bone-deep coldness suddenly surged into his heart, making his heart tremble and even his hair stand on end.
Momentum is something you can't touch or smell, but you can see it.
For ordinary people, momentum mostly comes from class pressure and the natural attributes of official position. But for a "gifted" person like Qin Yao, a glare or a frown is enough to make ordinary people tremble.
This is fierce power.
It belongs to the advantage of looks.
"Bastard, you dare to threaten my captain. Do you know how many times the gun hit you?" Later, Ah Wei, who came back to his senses, had a stress reaction in his heart. The more scared he became, the more he wanted to show his fierce side. He pulled out the pistol from his waist and pointed it at Qin Yao's forehead.
Qin Yao ducked in front of him, grabbed the pistol with his hands, rubbed his hands together, and the delicate-looking gun body was instantly crushed into a ball of iron.
"Bang!"
Under the expressions of all the policemen who had seen a ghost, Qin Yao slammed the iron block in his hand to the ground. After a deafening sound, a bottomless black hole appeared on the ground, with cracks all around the hole.
"You can't even hold a gun. How did you get the position of security captain in this town?"
Looking down at the black hole only two fingers away from his feet, Ah Wei shivered violently, and the sense of superiority in his heart instantly dissipated.
Just kidding, how can his flesh and blood body be as hard as the ground paved with cement?
With such strength, the other party could hit his head with a random stone picked up on the road. This kind of human weapon is obviously not something he can mess with!
"Why are you so stunned?" Qin Yao reached out and patted his shoulder.
"Hero, spare your life." The hair on Awei's body stood up as he fantasized about the scene in which his head would explode. He clasped his hands into fists and knelt down on one knee.
Qin Yao: "..."
This is the first time I have seen this kind of submissive posture.
"Master, junior brother is so majestic!" From the side, Wen Cai leaned into Uncle Jiu's ear and said softly.
The tone was full of envy.
Uncle Jiu glanced at him: "If you are willing to practice diligently, you will be the most powerful now."
Wencai: "..."
Blind chicken...talking nonsense.
Junior brother's spell cultivation is the same as mine, and he is a third-level human teacher. He can be so powerful only because of his talent. What does it have to do with cultivation?
"You are convinced now, but you are still dissatisfied in your heart, right?" Qin Yao looked sideways at Captain Ah Wei, half-smiling.
